commits.subject: net: TCrtSocket.Close only deletes a unix socket file it bound itself
commits.body:
Close unlinked fServer for every nlUnix socket, so a client opened on a
plain socket path with nlUnix deleted the server's .socket file when it
closed: the server kept running but could no longer be reached.
Unlink only when fWasBind is set, and cover it in DoUnixDomainSocket.
commits.author: Antoine Gaudreau Simard

files.patch:
@@ -2232,8 +2232,9 @@ function HTTP_RESPONSE.AddCustomHeader(P: PUtf8Char;
   else
     i := IdemPCharSep(P, KNOWNHEADERS);
   if (i >= 0) and
-     // WebSockets need reqConnection / CONNECTION: as unknown header
-     (THttpApiHeader(i) <> reqConnection) then
+     // WebSockets require reqConnection / CONNECTION: as unknown header
+     // and there could be several respSetCookie / Set-Cookie: values
+     not (THttpApiHeader(i) in [respSetCookie, reqConnection]) then
   begin
     while P^ <> ':' do
       inc(P);
